title: Tort Details

fields.label: Status Label
fields.name: status_label
fields.instructions: The exact wording shown on the badge, e.g. "Active · Filing Now" or "Settling · $1B+ Fund". The COLOUR comes from the Tort Status taxonomy in the sidebar — this field only controls the words. Leave blank to fall back to the status name.

fields.label: Category Pill Suffix
fields.name: pill_suffix
fields.instructions: Optional text appended to the category pill, e.g. "· #1 Largest MDL". Leave blank for most torts.

fields.label: MDL Reference
fields.name: mdl_reference
fields.instructions: Shown in the card footer. This is often what a visitor is searching for, so keep it accurate. Example: "MDL #2738 · Largest Active Mass Tort in the U.S."
fields.placeholder: MDL #2738 · Largest Active Mass Tort in the U.S.

fields.label: Settlement Estimate
fields.name: settlement_estimate
fields.instructions: The badge on the right of the card footer. Example: "Est. $300K–$5M+ per case" or "Pre-Settlement · File Now". Keep figures defensible — this is attorney advertising.

fields.label: Featured Tort
fields.name: is_featured
fields.instructions: Featured torts render as a wide, dark card spanning two columns with a pulled-out statistic. Use sparingly — roughly one per category.

fields.label: Featured Statistic — Number
fields.name: featured_stat_number
fields.instructions: The large figure in the featured card's stat panel, e.g. "67,100+" or "$1B+".

fields.label: Featured Statistic — Label
fields.name: featured_stat_label
fields.instructions: The caption beneath the figure. Include an as-of date so the number can be audited later, e.g. "Pending cases as of Q1 2026".

description: Card and detail-page fields for the tort post type. Category and status are taxonomies in the sidebar, not fields here.
